assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's three curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit, each status canonical with a false veto and each declaring Japanese tankobon V01-V37 plus an official web235-287 active_provisional overlay: OPM_CHARACTER_MODEL_READINESS_INDEX.md (100,271 bytes), OPM_HERO_CHARACTER_STATE_LEDGER.md (146,735 bytes) and OPM_RELATIONSHIP_STATE_LEDGER.md (96,631 bytes). Read: each item's front matter and framing sections and every section, row and line that names Genos, including the historical V08 matrix and the Checkpoint-A results the items report; sections about other characters were read only where they name him. The Checkpoint-A ledger, sequential readings, register audits and the legacy V1 Genos monograph are not curated on this subject and were not used. The project's 'strong' label is an input, not a conclusion; the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Collected V01-V37 (tankobon_canonical) and, as a separately labeled provisional state, the web265-278 overlay. States are split at located changes: V02 accepted discipleship; V06 categorical trust in Saitama; V18 Kuseno's survival instruction; V20 attack configuration with the ten-second ceiling; V30 (ch.154-155) refusal of collateral self-destruction; V33-V34 core extraction and second core; V37 雷光核 and the neighboring room. His pre-V01 loss and revenge vow belong to every state.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Located mechanisms: hierarchy updated by direct evidence with low status defensiveness (V01 ch.7 img 0146); deference that does not suppress causal disagreement (V02 ch.11 img 0078; the G-A-03 results the items report at V34 and V37); mission success over bodily preservation (V01 ch.6; V05 ch.26 civilian shield); capability pride with local inferiority acceptance and an engineered counter (V12); defeat routed to repair and return (V14-V15); revenge kept beside hero work (V08). The account says what changes his response: who is endangered, whether Saitama is implicated, whether the opponent is a readable mechanism, and the located hardware state. It predicts his overreach: maximum-output incineration under competitive pressure until Saitama stops him (V09) and sending King toward a threat on a false reputation (V18). Not A: contact with his revenge target and a real disconfirmation of his belief in Saitama are untested, and the predictions themselves are not curated. Not C: responses are discriminated across relationship, stakes, knowledge and chronology, and the record states where the account stops.

Per-volume entries V01-V37 with located transitions: accepted discipleship and registration (V02), categorical trust in Saitama (V06), survival-over-victory instruction from Kuseno (V18), the attack configuration with a ten-second full-power ceiling (V20), refusal of self-destruction with surviving heroes as collateral (V30 ch.154-155), core extraction and second core (V33-V34), 雷光核 and the neighboring room (V37). Not A: some volumes carry no direct state (V10, V13, V21) and the web265-278 overlay is provisional. Not C: state changes are located and earlier states keep their own boundaries.

The V01 voice baseline gives masculine 俺, serious explanatory speech much denser than Saitama's, plain severe judgment toward enemies (`所詮は虫か`, V01 ch.6 img 0129) and deferential request forms with 先生 and the attempted 師匠 toward Saitama (img 0140). Later recipient registers: anti-affiliation phrasing after a refused cooperation (`S級どもと馴れ合う必要は無い`, V06), rough peer address that coexists with real help toward Tatsumaki (V27-V28), polite contradiction of Saitama (V34) and the four-hour report (V35). Not A: few lines are quoted after V02 and no register audit is curated. Not C: the register rules are conditioned on the recipient and recur across V01-V37.

A recurring located pattern of observe, remember, solve practically and overprovide: the boxed drink bought after Saitama's unspoken look (V05 買えないモノ), rent negotiated to move in and a lesson diary (V03), hotpot procedure and guest etiquette (V08 海老), corpse cleanup on Saitama's routes (V15), his bargain-sale schedule used as evidence (V18, V20), gatekeeping a possible rival disciple (V18), and taking the neighboring room (V37). Not A: ordinary life is almost all oriented to Saitama, and his life alone is barely sampled. Not C: the pattern recurs with located instances across many volumes.

Directional, partner-specific policies: toward Saitama, idealization with independent causal reasoning, near-axiomatic trust recorded as his belief, and engineered proximity (relationship ledger V01-V37); toward Kuseno, technical entrusting with accepted protective limits (V08, V18, V24); toward Bang, advice heard but parsed (V04); toward Tatsumaki, rough address with shielding (V27-V30); toward Fubuki, care received and returned without membership (V29, V34); toward Drive Knight, constrained collaboration with disclosed risk (V28); toward Sonic, combat rivalry (V09). Not A: peer attachments outside the master and mentor axes are crisis-bound. Not C: the response policy changes with the partner, and the changes are located.

Located inner states: the categorical inference about Saitama (V06), self-comparison with Amai Mask as his own earlier state (V07), the inward question to an absent teacher whether this is right (V29), asking whether ethical restraint means becoming strong (V30), and exposed doubt about his strength (V31). Not B: inner life beyond strength and his teacher's approval (grief for his family, the feel of his revenge) is reported, not explored. Not D: several inner states are located and connected to conduct.

Mechanism-under-action recurs: steam diffusing light against G4 (V08), speed tracking against Sonic (V09), adaptive analysis of Garou with Garou already depleted (V16), mirror calibration and a bounded `勝てない` (V24). Also: secondary-effect reasoning about the meteor (V04), cooperation requests to peers, terminal self-sacrifice in early volumes, disproportion under competitive pressure (V09), hardware budgeting under the ten-second ceiling (V27). Not A: his ceiling is unsolved and his conduct against the revenge target is unknown. Not C: the conditions that change his tactics are explicit and repeat.

Positions change at located points, with reasons: early lethal instrumentalism (an offer to eliminate Sonic for his teacher, V02 ch.15 img 0180); civilian protection over his body (V05); respect for Saitama's chosen reputational cost (V05 ch.28 img 0156); Kuseno's survival-over-victory instruction (V18); renewed aid from remembered respect for life-risking resolve (V29); refusal of self-destruction with surviving heroes as collateral (V30); arguing for Pochi's second chance and for institutional reform (V35). Not A: his deliberation still seeks imagined validation from his teacher, and the ethics of his revenge are untested. Not C: the evidence explains why his ethical conduct changes across states.

Comedy arises from his earnestness: the lesson diary (V03), overprovision (V05), hotpot intensity (V08) and the same-day move demand, which the relationship ledger calls comic proof of proximity seeking (V37). The items record no joking or play that he starts. Not C: there is no account of his own humor. Not E: the comic pattern is located and recurs.

Entries for every collected volume in which he acts, V01-V37, with chapter and image locators and available-from fields, plus a labeled web overlay. Not A: the items are cumulative ledger summaries; the sequential readings, register audits and Checkpoint-A ledger are not curated on this subject. Not C: coverage of the collected run is complete at ledger level and located.

Affirmative limits are stated and located: disproportion under competitive pressure (V09); the categorical belief in Saitama flagged as a possible blind spot (V06); improvised acts read as deliberate pedagogy (V03); King sent toward a threat on a false reputation (V18); a mistaken King attribution (V31); an overgeneralized theory of perfect heroism (V34); self-measurement that fails to yield usable feedback (V37). Not A: these are not tested against held-out data in the curated items. Not C: several contradictions are located with their scope.

Volume boundaries, available-from fields and located splits (V20 hardware, V30 collateral refusal, V34 second core) are kept, and the items forbid backfilling later states. Not A: some deltas are summarized without image locators (parts of V03, V04, V11). Not C: most state claims are dated and located.

conditions: Illustrative written lines only, at a declared state, never presented as quotation or as imitation of Japanese lines.
Register by recipient: deferential 先生 request forms and dense explanation to Saitama; plain severe judgment toward enemies; rough address to S-class peers even while helping them.
No claims about comic timing, acoustic delivery or idiolect beyond the located forms.
scenario_readiness.note: Recipient-conditioned register rules and located lines constrain written register and function; quoted lines are few.

conditions: Before predicting, fix the state (the V20 ten-second ceiling; the V30 refusal of collateral self-destruction; the V34 and V37 hardware), who is endangered and whether Saitama is implicated.

Supported response families: mechanism analysis while fighting and escalation against severe threats; interposition for endangered civilians at bodily cost; defeat routed to repair and return; practical care and proximity seeking toward Saitama; respectful disagreement; disproportionate output under competitive pressure.
Abstain on an encounter with his revenge target, on a real disconfirmation of his belief in Saitama, on romance and on any state after web278.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One declared state inside V01-V37, with only what he knows at that point; web265-278 only as a separately labeled provisional state. His pre-V01 loss and revenge vow belong to every state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Saitama, Kuseno, Bang, the S-class and other heroes he has fought beside (as Tatsumaki, Fubuki, Drive Knight), Sonic as a rival, monsters and opponents, or endangered civilians; an unsampled but comparable hero colleague only as a separate, lower-confidence case.
setting_constraints: The hero society and Z-City domestic life as depicted in the collected manga.
No contact with his revenge target.
Counterfactuals keep his body, hardware limits and teacher relationship at the declared state.

scenario_readiness.note: A bounded extrapolation over sampled relationships and located hardware states.

conditions: Saitama's apartment, Kuseno's lab, Bang's dojo hotpot or a comparable domestic setting with these associates.
Supported: observe, remember, solve practically and overprovide; gatekeeping access to Saitama; earnest procedure in small tasks.
Strangers in ordinary life only as a separate, lower-confidence case.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary care is well sampled, but almost entirely around Saitama and a few associates.

conditions: Use the position held at the declared state: early lethal instrumentalism, later civilian protection, and from V30 no self-destruction with survivors as collateral.
Reasoning may appeal to Kuseno's survival instruction and to remembered respect for resolve; it still seeks his teacher's validation.
Abstain on the ethics of his revenge and on institutional choices beyond the V35 and V37 positions.
scenario_readiness.note: Located positions with explicit reasons, conditioned on state.
The items state that Fubuki's care and his response are neither consent nor romance (V34); no romantic conduct is recorded.

conditions: Hero Association summons, field coordination, rescue and reporting at a declared state, with his located institutional knowledge.
From V37 he treats membership as negotiable; do not project that back.
Abstain on command roles he never holds.
scenario_readiness.note: S-class hero work is his most densely sampled context.

known_limits.statement: Revenge against the rampaging cyborg persists (V08), but the target is never contacted in the curated evidence; how revenge ranks against hero duty and his teacher in a live encounter is not established.
His near-axiomatic belief in Saitama's invincibility is his belief, and no real disconfirmation occurs through V37.
Capability claims carry the located hardware state: the V20 ten-second full-power ceiling, the expended and dismantled bodies of V27-V33, the V34 second core and the V37 雷光核. No ceiling is solved.
His theories, such as the V34 branch hypothesis, his idea of perfect heroism and the V35 erased-history report, are his claims, not established facts.
The web265-278 overlay is active_provisional and settles no ceiling, independent victory or wider purpose.

The Checkpoint-A predictions and their scoring ledger are not curated on this subject. Only the results the items report (G-A-02 PARTIAL at V07 and CONFIRM at V08; G-A-03 confirmations at V34 and V37) were seen, and the items say they are not independent character evidence.
Grief for his family, the feel of his revenge, and his life away from Saitama, Kuseno and hero work are not analyzed in the curated items.
